design.hypothesis: One typed row/frame driver removes repeated per-channel row/disposal/depth checks and prepares alpha weights once per pixel across all four depth pairs.
design.endState: One closed typed row/frame implementation handles all four byte/word source/canvas pairs. Borrow row spans once; precompute alpha weights once/pixel. No Sample/SetSample calls, mode/cache/pool or duplicated kernels.
design.precision: Equal depths cancel a common sample maximum from numerator/denominator before exact positive half-up division. Rational value and final integer rounding are identical. Mixed depths preserve original full weights. Maximum numerator plus rounding remains below UInt64.MaxValue.
design.ownership: No new owned storage, reservation, temporary image, cache or retained state. Same source/canvas owners, pre-mutation local/borrowed admission, clipping, source-zero-alpha no-op, direction-preserving snapshot semantics and cancellation every256pixels.
